title: kbmon shows the query log, the host and the active sprint, and alerts loudly on a refused delivery
goal: the query log panel shows spool rows waiting, undelivered entries, the last distill and apply outcome and usage and cost today without prompt text; a refused query-log delivery shows as an alert on the first line of every view and in the snapshot's alerts; the host panel shows load, the whole-suite lock holder, the main lock holder and the suite ceiling status read-only; the sprint panel shows each active or approved sprint with its items' states, its waiting gates and its landings in progress; a log tail under the panels shows the newest coord events, ops rows and delivery outcomes one per line

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
